name: Engraving collage type
looks: On a warm off-white paper ground, a scrap of antique engraving or etching sits beside a short line of elegant serif display type, with one small accent-colour dot threading between them like a pin on a specimen board. The image reads as evidence, the type as the claim.
build: Engraving image desaturated to near-monochrome, placed directly on the page with no shadow or frame. Accent dot is a small filled circle at a natural eye-travel point, pulsing subtly (scale 1 -> 1.05, slow). Type and image arrive with a plain fast fade/lift (y: 6-10px -> 0, 200-300ms).
sound: Near silence or a very soft paper-like texture.
prompt: On a warm paper-coloured ground, place a piece of antique engraving or etching artwork beside a short line of elegant serif type, with one small accent dot threading between them as the only colour, letting a plain fast fade bring both in together so the pairing feels literary and considered rather than decorative.
